thread:
sanjay: Cutoff reminder — release window closes in ~6h. Can we run a quick green-sweep on release/v2.4 and call out any flaky blockers? :alarm_clock:

lina: On it. I'll kick off a full CI run against head of release/v2.4 and post failures.

chris: Pinged owners of open PRs in the merge queue. @elaine can you prioritize the changelog bump PR (#487) if CI is green?

elaine: Yep, will prioritize. I need a clean run — current CI shows 3 failures in unit-tests.

ci-bot: CI run started: pipeline id 98765 on release/v2.4 (triggered by lina)

lina: Quick paste of failing tests:
```
FAIL tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py::test_cache_eviction
FAIL tests/runtime/test_batching.py::test_batch_timeout
FAIL tests/serving/test_autoscale.py::test_scale_down
```

chris: test_kv_cache looks flaky — it's timing out occasionally on 16GB machines. I'll re-run just that job.

deploy-bot: Rerun queued: job 98765.2 (tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py)

michael: I saw a pattern where KV test fails when sequence_len=1024 in QAT mode. I pushed a small guard in onboarding fixture in my branch, but not merged. Can someone re-run with env VAR SKIP_QAT=true as a quick probe?

lina: Good call. Rerunning with SKIP_QAT=true on the integration job.

ci-bot: Job 98765.2 finished: PASSED

chris: Nice — kv_cache flake is gone. Next, batching test: failing trace shows a 1200ms spike on the batcher commit. Could be a scheduling hiccup on the pool.

elaine: For autoscale fail, the infra team recently adjusted the cooldown from 30s->60s. Could that affect the test? @michael?

michael: Yep, that explains the autoscale assertion timing. I'll adjust the test tolerance and open a small PR.

lina: Current status: 2/3 failing tests rerun -> 1 now passing, autoscale still failing but root cause identified. Delay on cutoff? We have about 4h left.

sanjay: Good detective work. Plan:
- chris/elaine: gate changelog PR on green from the adjusted autoscale test PR.
- michael: submit the test-tolerance PR and request quick review.
- lina: continue green-sweep on remaining merge queue (priority: security fixes, then changelog).
- If autoscale PR isn't merged in 2h, we ship with autoscale test flaky masked and follow-up patch post-release.

chris: I'll shepherd the changelog bump and can approve the test-tolerance PR if CI is clean.

elaine: added :spiral_calendar_pad: to my queue, will be on call for merges in the next 3h.

sanjay: Thanks — keep updates here. If anyone finds a true regression (non-flaky), escalate to #incidents and ping me directly. :thumbsup:
